verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that runs are stored locally on the phone and can be replayed or exported. No user control over retention periods or deletion of runs, traces or data sent to model endpoints is documented. Local storage is adjacent to the story, not a retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Every run is kept on the phone: replay it step by step with the taps and swipes drawn on top.
